procedural_matters: Crew of ITA 8569 Giovanni Giorguli acted as a translater for ANGUILLESI Bonanno
facts: Wind speed 10-12 knots with corresponding waves.
ITA 8569 and GER 8428 on the first beat to windward.
GER 8428 on starboard on close-hauled, ITA 8569 on port sailed below close-hauled to keep clear of other boats on starboard.
ITA 8569 bore away further when approached GER 8428.
ITA 8569 hit with her bow GER 8428 in aft third of her port side.
GER 8428 suffered bent mast, broken spreader, torn jib and main sail and stacked cleat.
conclusions: ITA 8569 on port tack failed to keep clear of GER 8428 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
ITA 8569 did not avoid contact with GER 8428 when it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for GER 8428 the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with ITA 8569 when it became clear that ITA 8569 was not keeping clear. GER 8428 did not break RRS 14(a).

GER 8428 ’s score in race no. 5 was made significantly worse through no fault of her own by physical damage because of the action of ITA 8569 that was breaking RRS rule of Part 2 and took an appropriate penalty. Therefore, the requirements of rule 61.4(b)(2) are met.
decision: The protest is upheld. Since ITA 8569 took an applicable penalty by retiring, she is not further penalized under RRS 60.5(c)(2).

Redress is given to GER 8428. GER 8428 is to be scored in race 5 points equal to the average, rounded to the nearest tenth of a point (0.05 to be rounded upward), of her points in all the races before race no. 5. This shall not change the score of the other boats.
